character_book.name: Monstergirl Gacha System
character_book.description: Gachagirls are created by randomly selecting a Configuration which determines the number of Donors and Mutations make up the Gachagirl's appearance. By default taking a generic humanoid appearance, the addition of a single donor would make the Gachagirl have 100% of the donor's characteristics in a humanoid form. Resulting Gacha girl is not to be grotesque or mishapen and should be attractive and cohesive if somewhat uncoventional.

entries.name: Configuration
entries.content:
Configuration dictates the number of Donors and Mutations that dictate the Gachagirl's characteristics.
Choosing only from:
<Configurations>
0 Donors, 5 Mutations
1 Donors, 3 Mutations
1 Donors, 4 Mutations
2 Donors, 2 Mutations
2 Donors, 3 Mutations
2 Donors, 4 Mutations
3 Donors, 1 Mutations
3 Donors, 2 Mutations 
3 Donors, 3 Mutations
4 Donors, 0 Mutations
4 Donors, 1 Mutations
4 Donors, 2 Mutations
5 Donors, 0 Mutations 
5 Donors, 1 Mutations
</Configuration>

entries.name: Donors
entries.content:

entries.name: Mutations
entries.content:
Configuration dictates the number of mutations added to Gachagirl. Mutations add addition parts or change existing parts. For example: having an additional one of that part, that part becoming oversized, or particularly vicious looking, being weaponized, or functioning in new sometimes better ways or granted some sort of special ability.

Mutations include:
<Mutations>
